messages:
elaine: Quick chase on PM RED-9001 (DB connection thrash)  Heads-up: two remediation items are past-due and one shows no owner in the tracker. This one was flagged as a recurring pattern in the postmortem. Can owners confirm status or reassign by EOD today?

rob: I'm listed for RED-9001a (connection pool backoff + metrics). I started a branch but got pulled to a pager. I'm unblocked now and can finish the PR today.

mira: I own RED-9001b (synthetic + alert tuning). Blocked on metric read permission, filed INC-6102 yesterday.

oncall-bot (sre-bot): Reminder: RED-9001a due 2026-06-02 (rob). RED-9001b due 2026-06-01 (mira). INC-6102 pending approval.

elaine: If INC-6102 isn't approved by noon I'll escalate to infra leads. This cluster is high priority given the recurrence note.

infra: INC-6102 approved by cloud-admins. Change logged 2026-06-01T10:12Z. Metric stream read access granted to mira.

mira: Thanks. Pushed synthetic PR: https://git.redwood.ai/pull/10021. PR merged, commit 5d7a1c2. Updated RED-9001b with commit, runbook link https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/db-pool#synthetic, and verification step (48h no connection errors). Set to "Ready for Verify".

rob: PR for backoff + metrics open: https://git.redwood.ai/pull/10018. Fixed flaky test and added logging. Commit a2b9f3e. Merged and deployed to staging. Updated RED-9001a with commit and deployment notes.

elaine: Great. Two quick asks before I close the cluster: 1) paste exact production deployment window in each ticket; 2) infra please add any permanent quota/permission changes to the change log so capacity reviews pick this up.

rob: Deployment to prod scheduled 2026-06-01 15:30 UTC. No rollback expected. Noted in RED-9001a.

infra: Permission/quota changes logged in INC-6102 with rationale and timestamp.

elaine: SRE verification scheduled for 48h window. @sre-bot can you run the automated check and report back?

sre-bot: Automated verification scheduled. Will check for connection errors and 5xx spikes for 48 hours starting 2026-06-01T15:45Z.

elaine: Also, add a short note in the PM tracker: ownership drift caused delay. Proposal: add an "ownership review" column and a weekly sweep to reassign stale items. I will create RED-9123 for that follow-up.

mira: Filed RED-9123 and linked to the PM.

sre-bot: Verification result: 48h window passed with no new connection errors at production traffic. RED-9001 follow-ups marked VERIFIED.

elaine: Perfect. I'm marking the postmortem action cluster as CLOSED in the tracker and adding the "ownership review" follow-up. If anything reopens, ping me immediately. :thumbsup:

infra: Action: Postmortem follow-ups for RED-9001 marked CLOSED by elaine.

rob: Thanks team. Learned to call ownership handoffs sooner when pagers hit.

mira: Closing my side.

elaine: Thread closed.
